notes.title: NATAANA patch is LIVE!
notes.notes:
Introducing shard crafting, faerie seed farming, ancient quests and more.

The Ancients have finally managed to open a portal to the Nataana Dimension. If you choose to abandon your quest to defeat the Black Knight on planet Turrin, you can take the portal to Nataana and experience a whole new world with new rules, a new environment, and new enemies.

The world's first player to craft the "Absolution" will get a monument to his bravery for all to see, in the Nataana Jungle Campsite.

Good luck, and thanks for playing Legend of Cenama!

notes.title: COSMOS patch is LIVE!
notes.notes:
New end game content, new areas, ancients and more. And of course we listened to your feedback and fixed the following bugs:

#1 Fixed a bug where the Catatonia Caverns entrance sometimes would get blocked after killing Firanama.
#2 Fixed a world map issue where players were able to reach Kanaami before
meeting Amateras.


Have fun, and thanks for playing Legend of Cenama!
